body:
## Outcome

Ship the core controls that establish Bloxwap visual identity and compose into every surface.

Roadmap: #1 · Milestone: M2: React and React Native components · Priority: P0 (required for v1).

## Scope

- Implement Button, IconButton, Link, Text/Heading, Stack/Inline, Surface/Card, and Separator from the audited designs using minimal useful abstractions.
- Reconcile app brand/secondary/outline/ghost/link and Pro primary/danger/compact variants into documented intent and density mappings; retain intentional differences.
- Support sizing, full-width versus content-width, icon/text composition, hover/focus/press, unavailable and busy/loading behavior, multiline labels, and semantic feedback integration points.
- Preserve safe activation, cancellation, target size, ref/focus semantics, and native text scaling. Do not couple a primitive to wallet/trading state.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Every supported component/variant has a state matrix and React/RN example using real Bloxwap tokens and fonts.
- [ ] Both renderers support large text, long labels, dense desktop layout, and touch targets without clipping or overlapping interaction areas.
- [ ] Busy blocks duplicate activation while preserving progress semantics; disabled controls cannot trigger actions or feedback.
- [ ] Keyboard and assistive-technology checks pass and imports contain no unrelated components.

## Prerequisites

- #12 — Implement shared component contracts and platform providers
- #9 — Specify motion and gesture behavior with reduced-motion alternatives
- #11 — Standardize Bloxwap brand marks and icon usage across web/native

## References

- [App](https://github.com/bloxwap/monorepo/tree/main/apps/app/src/components/ui)
- [Pro](https://github.com/bloxwap/monorepo/tree/main/apps/pro/src/components/ui)
- [Native](https://github.com/bloxwap/monorepo/tree/main/packages/ui-native)
- [Plain](https://github.com/bloxwap/monorepo/tree/main/packages/plain-ui)
- [Font](https://github.com/bloxwap/font/tree/main/apps/docs)

## Completion evidence

Link implementation PRs, updated docs/examples, and relevant validation results. Record platform limitations and any remaining catalog/adoption work explicitly.
